shown.message:
Nothing is owed to my role, so I pushed nothing and sent no messages. I checked the draft against the venue limits. The system's document build is of `paper-repo` `dev` commit 963fbe4, which already includes the full draft.

- **Length:** the main text ends on page 9 and the References heading starts further down the same page, so it fits the 9-page limit. The build has 19 pages in all, with the checklist starting on page 11.
- **Format:** Letter paper, `neurips_2026` style used with no options, and "Anonymous Author(s)" in the author block.
- **Abstract:** about 211 words, counted from `main.tex` with markup stripped. That is above the sample's median of 171 but inside its range of 87–240. The venue sets no abstract limit.

This is the last draft I checked, not a final version. I did not check the checklist answers. That belongs to `internal-review-repo`, which hasn't had a turn yet.
